title: SRI psi research

tellings.quote: then you have SRI you know know in the late 60s early 70s

plain: Michels points to research on psychic abilities, known as psi, carried out at SRI, a research institute in California, in the late 1960s and early 1970s. He names it only in passing, without saying what was studied or where he learned of it, as one link in a chain of serious institutions that took the paranormal seriously.
